title: Sin
description: Sin means missing the mark of who God made us to be. Every person has sinned, which is why we need a Savior.

waypoints.title: Missing the Mark
waypoints.body: Sin is thinking, saying, or doing anything that goes against God's good design -- and it isn't just the 'big' wrongs. Every person, from the first family to us today, has sinned. But God didn't leave us stuck there.

waypoints.title: Honest with God
waypoints.body: Is there something you've been afraid to admit to God or a parent? 1 John 1:9 promises that confessing it brings forgiveness, not punishment. Talk about why that's good news.
